2117009752949506348.en_summary: Last week earnings showed AI issues feared: $GOOGL AI disintermediation fear for search and big FCF miss; $MSFT neocloud partner pushing out capacity and first new fundraising bonds since 2017; $AMZN AI growth miss in AWS and FCF miss. Nasdaq -2.0%, Mag7 -2.4%, S&P -0.6%, equal-weighted S&P +0.8%. Google -12.6%, Amazon -3.1%, Microsoft -0.5%, $INTC -28.6% Friday. MSFT committed to staying FCF positive ($18.6B CQ3) and M365 likely default for safe AI via Co-Pilot. Meta using AI for efficiency, Muse hit, 18x CY27 PE for 28% growth but negative FCF and ~$95B equity raise, rating to AA- negative. AMZN missed AWS buyside ~42% with 39% but expects 40% CY27/28, LTM FCF burn $42.4B, $80B supplier financing, both e-comm and AWS to $1T in 5-10 yrs. GOOGL LLM back at frontier low cost/token but search miss 2nd qtr, first total rev/EPS miss since late 2022, FCF burn $9.1B, but search queries highest in 5 yrs, believes winner via Android. INTC near-term valuation reset but long-term foundry force; $SMCI preannounced 27% rev upside, $AMD reports Tue. $AAPL reports Mon after close, wary into earnings as beneficiary of avoiding AI FCF burns.
2117009752949506348.zh_summary: 上週財報呈現所擔憂的 AI 問題：$GOOGL 搜尋面臨 AI 去中介化擔憂且自由現金流大幅錯失；$MSFT 新雲合作夥伴推遲產能且自 2017 年以來首次發行新債；$AMZN AWS 成長錯失且自由現金流錯失。納指 -2.0%、Mag7 -2.4%、標普 -0.6%，等權標普 +0.8%。Google -12.6%、Amazon -3.1%、Microsoft -0.5%，$INTC 週五 -28.6%。MSFT 承諾維持自由現金流為正（第三季 186 億美元），M365 透過 Co-Pilot 可能成為企業安全 AI 預設選項。Meta 利用 AI 提升效率，Muse 受歡迎，CY27 18 倍市盈率對應 28% 成長，但自由現金流為負並擬募資約 950 億美元，評級調至 AA- 負向。AMZN AWS 錯失買方約 42% 預期（實際 39%），但預期 CY27/28 成長 40%，近十二個月自由現金流燒 424 億美元，80 億美元供應商融資，電商與 AWS 均導向 5-10 年達 1 兆美元。GOOGL 新 LLM 重回前沿且每 token 成本低，但搜尋連續兩季錯失，總營收與 EPS 自 2022 年底以來首次錯失，自由現金流燒 91 億美元，但搜尋查詢量為五年最高，認為透過 Android 將勝出。INTC 短期估值需重設，但長期將成晶圓代工力量；$SMCI 預告營收超預期 27%，$AMD 週二公布財報。$AAPL 週一收盤後公布，因避開 AI 自由現金流燒而受惠，但對財報持謹慎態度。
